findings.title: Known-bad provenance path points into a disposable worktree
findings.detail: knownBad.input pointed at a RedAnvil-fix-prov worktree path. meas-known-bad does existsSync and fails closed, so removing that worktree would have failed the rule for a reason unrelated to the app. FIXED: re-ran the checks from the canonical repo; 27 leaked paths now 0.

findings.title: Canvas fillStyle sentinel set but never read back
findings.detail: An unparseable fillStyle is silently ignored per the Canvas 2D spec, so the sentinel rgb(1,2,3) was reported as a real measurement (luma 1.87, dark true). Could not measure read as measured fine. FIXED: the sentinel is read back and throws, naming the colour it could not parse.
